claim_text_safe: The generalized SBL/HA-FBMS codec satisfies the tested clean-error and single-bit amplification bounds.
N3 provides frozen representations and locally searched mappings for the stated objectives.
HBM2 observations show strong position heterogeneity across the six-chip corpus.
forbidden_stronger_claim: HBM BER or simultaneous multibit probability

claim_text_safe: Cross-technology mappings are evaluated using domain-relative reference ratios.
limitations: DDR and HBM absolute objectives differ

claim_text_safe: On RTX5080 and RTX4060Ti, the largest tested workload shows no measurable additional mapped-SBL latency under the paired-block protocol.
limitations: all largest-workload CIs cross zero; kernel-only

claim_text_safe: The same representation and software mapping logic executes correctly on AMD gfx942.
AMD gfx942 performance is strongly backend-dependent for this kernel implementation.
limitations: software stack and kernel implementation specific

claim_text_safe: Deployment-calibrated HA-FBMS configurations show bounded metadata-fault amplification across Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B.
limitations: same codec family, not exact frozen N3 representations

claim_text_safe: Clean HA metadata adds no observed logit perturbation relative to raw INT4 in the tested full-cache one-step replays.
limitations: raw INT4 still differs from BF16

claim_text_safe: Corrected Binary32-Z is a same-width conventional baseline defined by uniform unsigned 32-bit quantization of log2(scale).
forbidden_stronger_claim: IEEE float z or historical N3 representation

claim_text_safe: In selected full-cache fault replays, HA-FBMS kept all tested scales valid and amplification below 2.
forbidden_stronger_claim: hardware fault probability or real HBM BER

claim_text_safe: P7 extends the evidence to a 32.76B-parameter Qwen3 model with 507,904 real scale groups.
forbidden_stronger_claim: full quantized generation or end-to-end latency

Semantic injection results quantify responses at localized target groups in a full-cache context.
